Name: (CP) Alternate Sheds
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
My [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23284]Buildable Camper mod[/url] was popular, so why not extend the concept; Robin can now build the Shed Deco, a new building that acts like a standard Shed but has all the Cabin skins.  The Shed Deco can then be upgraded into the Deluxe Shed, which acts like the Big Shed.  You can fully decorate the insides and the outsides can be painted.  Available skins are:

The outside dimensions are 5x2, same as the cabins but with the front row with the mailbox gone.  Shed Deco's interior is the same size as the regular Shed, 11x9, while the Deluxe Shed's interior is the same as the Big Shed, 17x12.  The Trailer Cabin skin is not included in this, as it's been turned into its own building in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23284]aforementioned other mod[/url].

Unlike the Cabin, each skin shows up separately in Robin's build menu, this is to allow them to have unique material costs.  When upgrading to the Deluxe Shed, the building will always upgrade to the current skin of the Shed Deco, regardless of which skin you choose in the menu; however, a different skin can still be chosen at any point using the Paint Building option for both the Shed Deco and the Deluxe Shed.  The Shed Deco cannot be painted, but all of the skins for the Deluxe Shed can.  I went ahead and extended the bottom corners slightly for each skin so that the building shadow lines up with the edge of the building.

The skins showing up as their own entries in the build menu is configurable with the "Separate Build Entries" option; by selecting false, the Shed Deco will only show up as one entry (defaults to the Plank Shed) and the different skins will not have unique resource costs; when upgrading, the Deluxe Shed will show up as the Plank Shed regardless of which skin you had selected before, this is simply an issue with how the upgrade system works on buildings with multiple skins. [b]For best performance on Android, "Separate Build Entries" should be set to false.[/b]

Sheds have seasonal variants, adding grass along the bottom of the building that changes colors through spring, summer, and fall, and snow and icicles on the rooftop during winter.

[b]Translate Me!
[/b]This mod has i18n support, so anyone who'd like to translate it can!

[b]Updates[/b]
ver 1.2: Added a config file so you can toggle on or off any skin.  This means if you know you're not going use a specific skin, you can set it to false in the config file, and it won't show up in the Carpenter's Shop menu.  If you turn off a skin that's already on one of your buildings, that building will revert to the Plank Shed skin, which is the default for the Shed Deco.  The Plank Shed skin cannot be turned off.
